title: Topang
description:
An adventure platforming game that spans 3 separate main characters' introduction stories. Help an alien named GB catch a strange fungal gastropod, or help Berl, an other-dimensional being climb to the heavens. An odd entity referred to as Skom could use some help as well. 

A 2-Player combat versus mode is featured containing 15 playable fighters. Each fighter possesses over 20 different attacks, including 6 unique special attacks.



- 3 Different Main Character Story Lines

- 2 Player Combat Versus Mode

- 15 Playable Versus Fighters

- Over 20 Moves Used by Each Character

- 6 Unique Special Attacks per Character



Must have 2 controllers for Multiplayer.
